guardrails: Former office titles do not count as current 2021 occupancy.
Criminal/legal events are not automatically converted to prominence scores; actual occupied role is coded.
Retrospective tenure evidence is allowed only when it explicitly spans 2021.
Untraceable is not a zero score.
